status: Everything here is proposed (P) except the anchors quoted from the regional histories, which are proposed lore of the R-45 histories; the owner decided only that these realms keep their own reckonings and that their text shows them (K30).
note: The local reckonings of the realms whose roster field calendar is not twelve (tools/content/data/world/roster.json). lib/calendar.mjs reads this file; modules/calendar.mjs writes the scripted localisation zin_reckoning_date from it. Forms use {year} (the 4A year), {month} (the god-month), {season}, {muster} (the month counted as a Muster, First to Twelfth), {leader} (the country leader), {yearOrdinal} (an era year with its suffix, 3952nd) and {reignOrdinal} (a Rising in words, twelfth).

ages.source: tools/content/data/world/history/east_lands.json overview: 1A 1 is year 1, the First Age runs to 1675, the Second Age from 1676 (2A 1) to 3808 (2A 2133), the Third Age from 3809 (3A 1) to 5068 (3A 1260, proposed length), the Fourth Age from 5069 (4A 1), so 4A 1748 is 6816
